subject: Private cluster: maintenance window request — version pin & contingency
messages:
From: Ben Williams <ben.williams@mercantile-sys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@mercantile-sys.com
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Private cluster: request for maintenance window (version pin + rollback)

Marissa,

Quick note from Mercantile SREs — we need to schedule a maintenance window to support Redwood's private deployment upgrade in our isolated VPC. Requirements:
- A firm version-pin guarantee for the cluster image and model variant during the window (we need to know you will preserve the pre-upgrade image for immediate reversion).
- A tested rollback procedure that can be executed automatically if error rates spike.
- Network/ops steps and expected service impact (we have compliance blackout from 02:00–03:00 UTC on 2026-11-18; preferable windows outside that).

Proposed window: 2026-11-18 01:00–04:00 UTC (Mercantile wants the maintenance compacted into a single narrow window). Can your team confirm: pin semantics, rollback automation, and whether you can run a quick canary beforehand?

I'll loop in Legal if we need a short SOW amendment. Attaching our change request form.

Thanks,
Ben Williams
Sr. SRE, Mercantile Systems
attachments: mercantile-change-request.pdf (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Williams <ben.williams@mercantile-sys.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private cluster: request for maintenance window (version pin + rollback)

Ben — thanks for the clear ask. We can support the compact window on 2026-11-18 but need to confirm a few operational commitments and sequencing details. High-level plan from our side:

1) Preflight & Canary (UTC 00:40–01:05) — run smoke tests against staging slice in Mercantile VPC, validate KV cache behavior and model inference p95 latency.
2) Version pin: we will pin the serving runtime and model variant at v2.3.1 for the window and hold the previous image (v2.2.8) marked as "reversion-ready". Pin means traffic routing will prefer the new image but we retain an immediate path to switch back.
3) Canary ramp: 02:00–02:15 small canary (1% traffic), 02:15–02:40 ramp to 10%, then 02:40–03:10 to 50% if metrics are green.
4) Automatic rollback trigger: if error rate >1.5% OR token-latency p95 increases by >40% for 5 continuous minutes, the rollback script will execute and traffic will revert to v2.2.8.
5) Network/ops steps: we will coordinate BGP drain and net-quiet commands with your NetOps. Karthik, can you confirm the BGP/quiesce sequence?

Attached: a compact staging-checklist and the rollback-script (stubs). Please review and confirm acceptance. If Mercantile insists on a non-overlapping compliance blackout, suggest 2026-11-18 04:00–07:00 UTC instead.

I will also open JIRA OPS-4123 for the work and share a short runbook link.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: staging-checklist.xlsx (stub), rollback-script.sh (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Williams <ben.williams@mercantile-sys.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private cluster: request for maintenance window (version pin + rollback)

Marissa / Ben — quick tech confirmation from infra:
- BGP/quiesce: we'll run net-drain on the cluster leading with ingress nodes (-T 120s), then withdraw BGP routes for the canary segment. NetOps (Mercantile) to confirm route acceptance.
- KV cache: plan to snapshot and warm the new node's KV cache pre-cutover. If rollback triggers, we will invalidate newly created prefixes and switch KV pointers back to v2.2.8 snapshot.
- DB migrations: none scheduled for this change. If anything requires schema migration we'll abort the compact window.
- Expected functional impact: we expect brief tail-latency spikes during the 10% ramp but not a full outage. The automatic rollback will perform an instant traffic reweight and a control-plane marker to prevent further routing to the failing image.

Operational check items I need before we commit: 1) Mercantile confirms route drain window and any intermediate firewall ACL changes; 2) Runbook owner assignment (I propose Soojin for rollback execution; Dev for rollback script verification).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 18:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private cluster: request for maintenance window (version pin + rollback)

Ben — confirming we will proceed with the compact approach on 2026-11-18 with the following commitments:

- Final schedule: Canary start 2026-11-18 02:00 UTC (preflight 01:40 UTC). Full run-through completed by 05:00 UTC if ramp continues.
- Pin guarantee: Redwood will pin runtime/model at v2.3.1 for the window and keep v2.2.8 marked as reversion-ready for immediate switch.
- Contingency: rollback-script.sh will execute automatically if the rollback triggers defined above fire; manual override operator is Soojin Lee.
- Network: Mercantile to confirm BGP drain acceptance by 2026-11-11 EOD.
- Compliance: we will not execute any schema or data migrations during this window.

Attachments sent: staging-checklist.xlsx, rollback-script.sh, maintenance-ack-schedule.pdf (signature stub). Runbook and postmortem doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/mercantile-maintenance-plan-20261118

Ben — please reply with explicit acceptance or an alternate compact window. If we don't hear back by 2026-11-11 23:59 UTC we'll assume tacit acceptance of the 02:00 UTC canary start and proceed with the preflight run.

Best,
Marissa Cole
